subject: both the hippie van and oval
author: SirRonBurgundy
body:
both the hippie van and oval steel are simply paint options at the junk yard. They are added paint options called 'community'. I was over the excitement of those in about 5 minutes. Pretty limited and lame if you ask me, why not just add a new paint option for each car, not just two? Seems like it wouldnt be a ton of work, but whatever. I've also heard a rumor that they will do the new car weekends for the next four weeks. Not sure how accurate, but that's what some were chatting about in a room last night.

What I'd like to know is..........how are some people tweaking/cheeting in ranked racing rooms and able to choose different cars than those offered. I'm sick of racing the Ikuza, then somehow I'm racing against everything from a Touge to a Hawker. What gives??
